subject: Outdoor Dining Ordinance Update
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to review draft updates to the city's Outdoor Dining Ordinance with representatives from the Office of Planning, Development and Sustainability. The committee approved several amendments regarding accessibility enforcement, severability clauses, and tiered fee structures before voting to report the paper out to the full City Council.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Ordinance Update (Paper 22-514)
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed edits to the Outdoor Dining Ordinance with staff and voted to report the paper out of committee as amended.
